notes.title: Protonwar - 0.6 - Melee Combat Update!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/ad3f426ba3617346d77e91a73db070356368ad5e.png

ps. Wrist Straps.
I highly recommend that you now use the wrist straps that come with your vr controllers, if not already!
I also recommend turning on show gaurdian for oculus, and show chaperone for steamvr if that is what you use! :-)


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/1c25aab407606b979b838b1caf0caae81e23fa94.png


MELEE COMBAT!
Im so excited to announce that Melee combat is finally here!
Each character gets 1 selectable Melee weapon, which can be choosen from the character menu.
Each weapon comes with unique characteristics.

Use your Melee weapon to block projectiles, or to damage your enemy, or simply just humiliate your enemy by attacking their ragdoll after you take them out ;-)

The damage is dependant on the velocity of the hit, and the shape / size of the weapon you have chosen.
In vr you get 1-1 sword movement as you would in real life, with proper IK so you see exactly where your enemy's sword is.
In non vr there is 6 differnt attack types, Up left, Mid left, Down left, Up right, Mid right, Down right.

Because its really really fun, there is also a mutator for Melee only mode!



NEW GAME MODE! - HUNT THE FLAG
There is now a new game mode called "Hunt the Flag" (rabbit)...
It is a Free for All game mode, at the start of the match a flag is spawned at a random location on the map.
Players get 1 point for a kill, as normal, but get 2 points for a kill when holding the flag.
While holding the flag players get given a point every 3 seconds.

Person with the most points at the end of the round wins.
This will now be the default mode on the official servers.

There is also a new flag, which gets holstered onto the character when carrying. 8-)


WEAPON WHEEL, NO MORE...
The weapon wheel has been removed, as it was the #1 complaint.
On the vive you now can select your weapon up and down using the up and down on your primary hand track pad.

On the rift it is a bit differnt, The bottom button on your primary hand switches to previous weapon, the bottom button on your sec hand switches to next weapon.
The top button is still used for climb / special jump. This due to the grip being fine for climbing, but very clumsy for the jump.




Lots more!...
Massive optimization passes on Overgrown, and Swamp Lands, along with some layout / item placement adjustments on Swamp Lands.
Lots of small issues have also been resolved, too many to list...


Please remember to use your wrist straps while playing, it will save the surprise of the controller flying out of your hand! (like mine! ;)

Have fun!!!
-Gozu
ːsteamhappyː


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/461410/ss_e8db543cbc40c7b10d75eee1b5341f304fb533f2.1920x1080.jpg

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.20HF1 - Horde Fixes and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/876e5b62be13744439cee492a1dd8436b046ebb2.png




Hi Guys,

In this patch you can now play the horde mode in any map!
This now can be accessed via the Quick Match menu, and selecting "Horde"
There is also a new HUD widget for the horde mode, displaying the wave details directly on the HUD, and in VR "floating" in your view
The way Health regen works has also been changed. It now starts regenerating when you get below 20 health, and does so quicker, then stops until you get below 20 again. This new way works much better for shoot/cover game play
As per usual the horde mode is fully multiplayer co-op and your games will show up in the server browser.

When you spawn into the map for Horde Mode a red beacon will shoot up into the sky, one will spawn for each zone location, go here for the baddies!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/2302881da5768a7b46dbfd915fa55014b267793f.png

These changes greatly improve the Horde mode to be much more fun. If you make it to the final wave i have some small surprises for you ;)

There will be even more changes coming soon to the Horde mode in the future,

Which leads us to...
There is now a new Player Stats link in the main menu!
The game is now recording lots of stats, and the important ones are shown here.
There is also a currency, called "Protocoin", this is calculated based on your damage given and damage taken. It is not used for anything yet, just some idea's that i am toying with for the Horde modes.
This will soon be merged into the leaderboards and run through Steam Stats...

There have also been some memory leaks which were leading to degraded performance over time, which have now been resolved.



Thanks for supporting early access!
Tell your friends!!!!
Leave feedback!
Most importantly, Have fun and go frag some space dudes!


:)
-Gozu, out.

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.16 HF1 Patch 29/10/2016
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/0a90e0c3d067e4674044172eded5f1a0248d8621.png


Added new music from The Mechanism. http://themechanism.co.nz !

Added basic weapon interactions, dropping and picking up weapon in VR,
This is done using the GRIP button on the right controller.
"Zoom" button has had to be moved, this is now the system button...
- Weapon is dropped as drop item
- anyone can pick it up
- after 120 seconds of a drop it will automatically return to your inventory
- when picked up player gets given all the ammo that the previous owner had for that weapon
- share weapons with your team mates etc!
- to pick back up, hold your right hand next to the item and press grip again

- This is just the beginning for this and will get more work done allowing you to throw weapons at people and damage them etc...
- other thing on the to do list, is to add a holster for the stapler so you can quickly holster and change to that, and perhaps the assault rifle as well


Scoreboard in VR moved to menu console to accommodate new zoom/scope button...
Added gamepad sensitivity options for vert and horz look sensitivity
New ragdoll VFX


Various bug fixes, cleaning up some rare exceptions...



In other news, Protonwar is featured at Paris Games Week this week.
If at PGW, go check out the Lenovo booth with ESL and play some Deathmatch in Protonwar!

Patch Notes: Protonwar 0.15, its a big one!


Lots of stuff, here is a big list!
Just get in and play! If you do not like the shattered glass effect on death, let me know!!!

General:
NEW MAP! DM-Ruins, designed as a cover shooter map for VR. This map is also insanely good for the Parkour mode in Non VR :)
New Pistol animations
Fixed lava damage sounds
Fixed projectile impact decal bug on meshes
Assault now starts with full ammo
Tweaked Stapler Gun vfx, sfx, speed
Tweaked AI mesh scale to be more "Real"
Death camera now stays on pawn, added shattered glass post effect on death

Standing VR:
Added trackpad movement option! (Settings -> Input -> Config Motion)
Added Motion Controller preset's for differnt preset controls similar to the gamepad ones, your preset is saved as soon as you select it...
FOV reducer is now just either on or off. Effect is now also more apparent.
All first person weapon scales tweaked in VR, and hand mesh sizes tweaked
Improved Haptic Feedback
Improved laser sight for Assault Rifle and Sniper Rifle
Improved sniper scope, fixed bugs with some distant objects not showing (hold down grip on right hand when using sniper rifle)
Fixed bug that allowed teleportation through invisible walls
Fixed death camera so HUD is still visible and rotation remains consistent


Seated VR, Non VR:
Fixed some camera roll issues in seated vr
Improved AI in Time Tag mode
Added fancy post effect when tagged in time tag (freeze!)
Tweaked info message hud fonts
Fixed crash caused by weaponbar


Known Issues:
Sliding in Non VR and Seated VR is now a bit bugged
Camera roll in Seated VR Parkour is not very smooth
AI still sucks, but is getting better, it is pretty "dumb" on purpose ;)




PLANS FOR THE COMING MONTH:
Full body IK, and possibly new arms/hands for Standing VR (very soon! and i promise to fix the bot aim to look nicer :)
Another new DM map, with another new theme, that can be re-purposed as a horde mode map
New shotgun model
New Photongun model
Some new meshes for some of the pickups
Invisibility power up on the new map ;)
More variety for Horde AI + Horde character models\
Improved replay features *in vr*
more tbd!


Have fun guys!

It's beautiful. It's like liquid it... slides all over everything. Comes up in waves. And they just kept hitting him, wave after wave.

Patch Notes:

"Project Holo" renamed to simply "Horde Mode"
Horde Mode added for Non VR and Seated VR!!! These modes will still require a bit more work for non vr or seated players as they are balanced for the standing mode. This will happen shortly :-)
Third Person mutator added! (only supported in Non VR or Seated VR currently)
AI path finding tweaked
AI low ammo behaviour re-written/fixed
Fixes for IK aim rotation being off
Menu optimizations
Particle systems optimizations


VR Movement Modes for Standing VR Explained

Please bare with us, as these are most certainly a work in progress. We will be starting to focus a bit more heavily on Locomotion and specific room scale vr tweaks over the next few weeks.
These options have been tweaked a little bit, to offer two options, under the menu you have an option, enabled by default "VR Movement From Marker"

This will act like so:
You press the trigger to "engage" the movement. A red dot shows up on the screen.
The movement is relative to this dot.
Release the trigger to reset this. (tip: don't hold it down all the time)

If this is disabled it will behave like so:
Press trigger to engage move
Movement will go towards to controller, relative to its location from the camera (this is the old system)

Choose whichever mode you feel more comfortable with.

VR Locomotion revisit
Testing of both the nvidia branch and oculus branch of the engine to to see if improvements such as multi res shaders will be of any benefit to us
Weapon Wheel implementation

notes.title: Patch 0.11 HF2! - For the Rift
notes.notes:
Hi Team,

Here is a patch to address all of the issues with the Oculus Rift. (height issues and menu issues)

If the camera pitch is something that you do not like, please try out the alternate mouse mode by pressing "M"
Please NOTE: HOLO servers are for VIVE only.

Here are some helpful tips to help you out if you are having issues with the Rift:

How to get into the game:
Start SteamVR
Wait for SteamVR to load and confirm all devices are detected
If using a Control Pad turn this on now
Open your Steam Library and browse to Protonwar
Ensure that the play icon indicates "Play in VR"
If it does not check your SteamVR setup
Click on Play In VR and put your headset on
Protonwar will then ask you if you want to play standing or in seated mode, as a Rift user, select “Seated” mode.

Tips:
To select menu items simply look at the button and press Space Bar or Right Trigger on your control pad
To get back to the menu once in game press escape. and press Q to go to the main menu
 If your movements are not tracked correctly please calibrate your sensor via the oculus home application. See https://support.oculus.com/help/oculus/449651231906396/ for help
If you move your sensor you may need to calibrate again

*If you are uncomfortable with camera movement, try the alternate mouse mode by pressing the “M” key*


Cheers.

notes.title: Protonwar - Patch 0.11
notes.notes:
Protonwar - Patch 0.11 

Hi Team!

This patch is quite significant in a few ways so i decided to post up a small write up here.

 First big thing i would like to announce is the addition of Gamepad support.
This will function in the Seated VR, and Non VR game modes! :-)
This means, just to make things easier that i have updated the seated vr menu navigation to be based off the direction you are looking at. Simply move your head around to move the cursor, then press "Space bar" or "Right Trigger" to select an item in the menu. If you are having issues with the cursor being off center, please rotate your character using the right stick (this will be resolved shortly)
In the last patch i also added a fancy new cursor, that animates when you click on things, just to improve usability in the UI.

 Second big thing i would like to announce is the inclusion of a new teleportation system.
The teleport function in Standing VR now uses a parabolic arc. This means that you can now teleport up onto ledges, or down onto ledges.
Use the teleport the same way you used to "Left Facepad Up" on the vive motion controller. If you are trying to get to an area where you cannot reach, the teleport effects will display as red. If you are good to GO, they will display as blue, release the trigger and zap to your new location!
Dont forget that this will use up some of your energy stats, so keep an eye on this and reserve it for pulling off that quick escape, or grabbing the epic health before your enemy does!

Third thing is the inclusion of a new announcer!
There is now many more voice announcer calls setup, with a nice meaty sounding announcer voice to pump you up during the fight.

Fourth thing
There are some small HUD changes in relation to movement with the HUD. If you stand still not moving the HUD will no longer rotate with you, once you start to move forward it will snap to your rotation.
This is just the very very very beginning stages of the changes that i will be making to hud, to make it a bit cooler, and hopefully help with orientation. Lets see how this small change pans out for starters.

In the background, we have been doing some optimizations around network performance, and improved it a bit in the previous patch. I will be keeping an eye on this but at the moment the network performance should be very good, so gear up your mates, and give it a shot.
We will soon have the Steam friends list integrated directly into the game, just to make this a bit easier for you.


Please note that the new gamepad support, does not allow you to play against motion control users, they are separate game modes.
How ever we do plan in the very near future to branch out the holo mode to the seated vr and non vr users.
Also keep in mind that this is initial support, that will be tweaked a bit in the future. Things such as slowing the character down while scoping, toggling walk run etc, are not implemented as of yet.

One more thing, if you are getting a crash to desktop from the game, we have detailed instructions over here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/461410/discussions/3/366298942100280873/
about what you can do before submitting a bug report to assit with speedy resolution.
If you get a crash first try restart the game, see if it happens again, then try restart your PC, and ensure that your video drivers / windows updates are up to date before submitting a report.


Here is an image of the currently assigned gamepad controls, they are currently not editable from the menu, but this is another feature that will be added very shortly.

New Gamepad Controls:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/e7bf210e9442baae32eda230c81ef0a4990be39e.png

notes.title: Patch notes 12/07/2016 and Project Holo CO-OP notes
notes.notes:
Hi Guys,

I would just like to take a brief moment to discuss some various things, such as the Project Holo gameplay mode that i have included.

It is in quite early stages and much more experimental than the multiplayer sections of the game (The AI is not the best!), but this mode is here as a CO-OP online multiplayer wave shooter mode.
There are some bugs if played in co-op where the character that is not the host does not see some of the UI notifications, but all of the actual gameplay stuff works sweet as in co-op. Hiding behind cover, ducking, gunplay, teleporting, all off the good stuff, you can even start a match using any of the supplied mutators.

IK / Character Animations:
No one has asked about this but i figured it was worth mentioning, and discussing how this is implemented currently.
Your head movement is tracked, and this movement is replicated across the network. Its pretty creepy having people look at you! almost surreal.
The hand IK is something that gets generated from just your gun holding hand, and to some degree it is tied to the animations.
It is done this way to avoid having everyone running around with their arms flailing about the place. This may change in the future, but the current approach is a little more serious, geared towards making the character animations with the gun better.

That brings up a few other points. The animations are all mo-capped from a trained professional with weapon handling experience, there will be more added, including taunting. There are some issues with left hand placement, and this will be fixed with IK in the future.

We are tracking and replicating all of the head data, and left and right hand.




I have just this minute finished uploading the latest patch after some rigorous testing, not much content, as it has been mainly bug fixing/testing to clean up the UI bugs.

Patch Notes:
Non VR ingame menu issues fixed.
Non VR, movement input config added (axis bindings)
VR menu interaction has now changed, this should be much more reliable for people, and resolved for those that had issues clicking on items.
VR default options, increased screen resolution to 140% for default.
Small UI tweaks here and there.
General stability improvements; Potentially some more caused by various HW configs, these are generally engine bugs that are being worked on.


Thanks again for the positive responses, and the discussion around features that you want to see.

Its truly AWESOME to see you guys enjoying it so far.

Please feel free to get out there and share your experiences on places such as Reddit or Twitter or what not. I will have some review copies going out today and hopefully start generating some more interest to get more players on board!

Till next time!
